messages.text: Right, you are sending updates about the program?

Yes, Rob. Every update about your request comes by email to (email hidden), the address on your orders. Our emails sometimes end up in spam, so check there too.

I need one answer so the team gets it right. Is the plan still two 40Ts in total, with the KBOX and both Thor P2s coming back to us? Or are you keeping the KBOX for one of your kids and dropping the switch?
yes two T40 machines get sent to me me, In the time being the unit is & I will send out order. Thank you for your help, worked 25 Years with this kind of stuff. Can you send the money back?
Handed to the team · Settling the KBOX value against a 40T and any money back needs a person; RMA set

Got it, Rob. Two Magic M. 40Ts in total: your pre-order on Shop···· plus one Batch 10 in place of the KBOX. The Thor P2s come back to us sealed.

On the money, you paid $824.49 for the KBOX and a 40T is $799. I've asked the team to confirm that difference and how it gets back to you. Nothing on the KBOX can be settled until it reaches our warehouse, so send it with Shop···· written on the box.

Someone will pick up your ticket and email you the answer at (email hidden)
no no no. That is wrong. I JUST WANT THE TWO MAGIC MINER 40TH
Handed to the team · Customer corrected the request; the second 40T and the P2 return need a person.

I've fixed it, Rob, sorry for the mix-up. No money back, no B30. You want the two Magic M. 40Ts and nothing else: the one you already have on order, and one more in place of the KBOX.

I've corrected your request with the team. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you at (email hidden)
Ok great, my apologies for the entire messup.

No need to apologise, Rob. It's sorted now. Two Magic M. 40Ts in total, the KBOX goes back with Shop···· on the box, and the Thor P2s come back sealed.

The team will email you at (email hidden) once they've set it up. Good luck with the drop-off tomorrow.

Sounds good, Rob. You can come back to this chat any time and I'll pull up where things stand. The team's answer will also go to (email hidden), so check your spam folder if you don't see it. Take care.
ok, now im not sure. You said the answer still needs to come from you?

No, Rob, sorry if I made that confusing. The answer comes from the team, not from me. They'll set up your second 40T and email you at (email hidden) with the details and the return label for the Thor P2s.

You don't need to do anything else except send the KBOX back. If you come back to this chat, I can tell you where things stand.
I agree to return the KD box as soon as I get the address. If there is one, I can handle it.

Here it is, Rob. Send the KBOX to:

ShipBob, Inc. [ATTN: Returns]
(address hidden)
Chattanooga, TN (postal code hidden)

Use the prepaid UPS label we emailed you on November 11 (tracking ····). It's free, and the address is already on it. If you can't print it, show the label email or your photo of it at a UPS Store. Write Shop···· on the box.

This is the GekkoScience KBOX from order Shop····, serial GS-10120092.
